Families displaced by violence in central Mali are starting over in Sarema, located 640 kilometers north-east of the capital Bamako, in the Mopti Region. While some arrived just a few months ago, others have been here since late 2024.

results.snippet:

Skydagger is also working to establish drone manufacturing plants in five different countries.
